member.name: T:Shared.Constants.AfterSalesSyncSettingKeys
member.summary:
Setting keys for the 4Seller after-sales (return / refund) sync — managed via admin Settings.
Two independent loops, because they are two different systems doing the work: trigger asks 4Seller to pull fresh return cases from TikTok Shop into its own database, pull reads those cases back into ours. Running them on separate clocks lets the pull stay cheap while the trigger, which costs a TikTok round-trip on 4Seller's side, runs rarely.
This flow owns Order.PlatformOrderStatus = REFUND, Order.RefundedAt and Order.CancelReason. Order sync only latches what this flow wrote.

member.name: F:Shared.Constants.AfterSalesSyncSettingKeys.RefundedAtCreateTimeRepair
member.summary:
One-shot marker (done) for the pass that re-stamps Order.RefundedAt from the return case's platformCreateTime. Earlier runs stamped platformUpdateTime, which moves every time the platform touches the case, so the refund clock drifted forward and the refund list sorted nothing like TikTok Shop / 4Seller.
Not seeded as a user-facing switch: clear the value to run the pass again.

member.name: F:Shared.Constants.AfterSalesSyncSettingKeys.OrphanRefundReconcile
member.summary: One-shot marker (done) for the pass that released orders from REFUND when their return case was still open. Superseded by , which reverses that rule — kept only so the settled row is recognisable in Settings.

member.name: F:Shared.Constants.AfterSalesSyncSettingKeys.RefundCasePresenceReconcile
member.summary:
One-shot marker (done) for the full reconcile that makes local REFUND mirror 4Seller's returns list: an order with a case (complete or still running) belongs in the refund tab with its clock set to the case's create time, and an order no case mentions at all does not belong there.
Not seeded as a user-facing switch: clear the value to run the pass again.

member.name: F:Shared.Constants.AfterSalesSyncSettingKeys.ReturnStatusBackfill
member.summary:
One-shot marker (done) for the pass that backfills Order.ReturnStatus from 4Seller returnStatus onto every refunded order. Pull incremental only re-reads cases that changed since the watermark, so without this pass OrderCards would keep a blank status line until each case next moves on 4Seller.
Separate from (already done) so that pass is not re-run; clear the value to run again.

member.summary:
Reads the TikTok publish failure that names a product attribute value it will not accept.
Sample, as it arrives through 4Seller's failedMessage (sometimes behind a 【Publish Failed】 prefix): Operation Not Allowed. Cannot use custom value names for product attribute `Washing instructions`: attribute ID `100401` does not support custom value names. Remove or replace the custom value `Do not dry clean` and retry.
